name: flags
meaning: flags byte; elastic_Init 0x4b80f1 sets it to 3 at 0x4b8156

name: app
meaning: Mesh_BuildFromBsFile's FIRST argument (0x40c246-0x40c249); Mesh_TransformAll reads [[this+8]+0x28], the IDirect3DDevice7 (0x40d1b8). Was 'srcRecord': the record is argument 2 ([ebp+0xc], read at 0x40c252).

name: vbPositions
meaning: D3D7 vertex buffer for positions. Mesh_BuildFromBsFile allocates a scratch of vertexCount*0xc (three floats per vertex), fills it, then calls vtable +0xc (Lock), memcpy's vertexCount*0xc bytes in, and calls +0x10 (Unlock) - those are IDirect3DVertexBuffer7::Lock and ::Unlock

name: vbTransformed
meaning: destination of IDirect3DVertexBuffer7::ProcessVertices (vtbl +0x14) in Mesh_TransformAll 0x40d1ea, transforming vbPositions (+0xc); also filled by Lock/memcpy/Unlock in the build. Was 'vbSecondary'.

name: vertexCount
meaning: vertex count, taken from BsFile_PeekEntryCount 0x41bc0f - i.e. the u16 at geometry record +8. It sizes every allocation in the build at 0xc bytes per vertex

name: faces
meaning: the face array (Mesh_Construct 0x40c1b0 nulls it; Mesh_Destruct frees it when faces and faceCount are both non-zero); elastic_Init stores its constructed RenderPoly array here at 0x4b836f

name: faceCount
meaning: number of faces in the array; elastic_Init stores 8 at 0x4b82ec (dword store). Completes the 0x20-byte object that elastic_Init allocates at 0x4b80fe
